Cifra Keyboard is a fork of Simple Keyboard (github.com/rkkr/simple-keyboard) by Raimondas Rimkus and contributors, which is based on the LatinIME keyboard of the Android Open Source Project. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Simple Keyboard authors.

Third-party components:
• Bouncy Castle Crypto APIs, MIT License
• BIP39 English wordlist (bitcoin/bips), MIT License
• Material icons, Apache License 2.0

Cifra Keyboard has no internet permission and sends nothing anywhere: no analytics, no crash reports, no ads.

Only on this device, it keeps:
• your identities: name, public key and the private key sealed by the Android Keystore;
• your contacts: name and public key;
• the keyboard settings.

It never stores your BIP39 words, your passphrase, or the messages you write or decrypt. It reads the clipboard only on this device, to find encrypted messages.

Backups are disabled. "Erase all keys" deletes identities and contacts; uninstalling the app deletes everything.
